title: AI Programme Engagement and Delivery - Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
Citi is looking for a Vice President, AI Programme Engagement & Delivery to join the Client Organisation AI Lead team — a group that directly supports revenue growth managing Credit, Marketing, Research, Client Delivery, and Ventures on behalf of Citi's businesses. In this role, you will coordinate and support the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives, ensuring governance, stakeholder alignment, and programme reporting operate to the highest standard. Sitting at the intersection of project management, governance, technology, and artificial intelligence, this position offers significant exposure to senior leadership and meaningful contribution to Citi's AI transformation agenda.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
Joining Citi's Client Organisation AI Lead team means stepping into one of the most strategically significant programmes in global banking today. You will be part of a high-performing central team that directly shapes how AI is adopted and embedded across Citi's business activities — with real visibility, real influence, and real career momentum.
  
  

* Direct exposure to Citi's AI operating model and the opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI adoption in financial services, developing a highly sought-after skillset in a rapidly evolving field.
* Regular interaction with and visibility to senior leaders across the Client Organisation, the Office of AI, and broader Citi leadership.
* A platform for significant career growth, with the ability to build expertise across programme delivery, controls, analytics, and AI governance in a complex global organisation.
* Hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting a sustainable and productive work-life balance.
* Access to Citi's global learning and development resources, enabling continued professional growth across technical, leadership, and domain skills.
* Competitive financial wellbeing benefits and a comprehensive package aligned to your seniority and contribution.
* A collaborative, performance-driven team environment where your work has measurable impact on Citi's strategic AI agenda.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Coordinate the day-to-day delivery of the AI programme, managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and ensuring milestones are met on time and to a high standard.
* Organise governance practicalities of the AI Lead team, including tracking actions, maintaining decision logs, and ensuring controls documentation is accurate and up to date.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, technology, risk, and control functions, keeping all parties aligned on programme status, priorities, and key decisions.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise reporting on programme progress, issues, and risks to audiences ranging from working-level teams to senior management.
* Provide analytical support including data analysis, visualisation, and presentation-quality reports that inform decision-making at programme level – driving data informed decision making.
* Monitor adherence to relevant policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, and support the implementation of business-specific controls across the programme.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that teams can act on directly.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* Five to ten years of experience in programme delivery, business management, PMO, or controls within the financial services industry.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced, complex environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to produce clear, impactful presentations and reports for senior audiences.
* Skilled in data analysis and visualisation, with a strong analytical and evidence-based approach to problem-solving.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience engaging stakeholders from junior analysts through to senior management.
* Working knowledge of governance frameworks, internal controls, and documentation standards within financial services.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience supporting cross-functional programmes within a large-scale, global organisation.
* Experience supporting AI, data, or technology initiatives within a complex, cross-functional organisation
* Familiarity with AI or machine learning concepts at a foundational level, with an interest in how these technologies are applied within financial services.
* Awareness of enterprise applications and business process frameworks relevant to financial services operations.
* Experience negotiating with or managing relationships with external parties such as vendors or third-party programme partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
* MBA or CFA or CA preferred

Apply now to bring your programme delivery expertise to one of the most impactful AI initiatives in global financial services — and help shape the future of Citi's client capabilities.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant team.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's in technology / bachelor's in science in a related field is required; Preferably in Business, Finance, Economics, Applied Math or related fields with quantitative training
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5-6 Years
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross-functional D&T teams.
* Technical Skillset - AI / Automation Activation, Adoption & Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization,
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy·
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM-enabled workflows is preferred.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**Summary:**

* Leads the end-to-end delivery of large-scale, complex initiatives, from strategic definition and planning through to hands-on tactical execution and successful implementation.
* Serves as a key partner to senior business and functional leaders, building cross-functional alignment and acting as the primary point of contact for stakeholders up to the Managing Director level.
* Manages high-visibility programs critical to firm-wide strategy, navigating varying levels of complexity to deliver measurable business value with executive-level sponsorship.
* Drives transformational change by deploying advanced process improvement and operating model design methodologies, while also developing new approaches and building change capabilities across the organization.
* Accountable for program success, measured by the tangible business value delivered, positive stakeholder feedback, and contributions to the firm's thought leadership.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Deliver high-impact operating model and process transformation projects by identifying business needs, validating pain points, and developing the business case for change.
* Establish and execute robust program governance aligned with enterprise standards, developing detailed project plans, backlogs, and user stories to guide execution.
* Lead the scoping, design, and execution of target operating model and process transformation initiatives; partner with senior business, operations, and functional leadership to establish business cases, strategic roadmaps, and business requirements for complex programs.
* Partner with business and Technology to oversee and guide technical delivery, aligning solutions to target operating models, business requirements, and operational priorities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Drive accountability and engagement by holding project teams responsible for deliverables and performance, while providing critical review and challenge to status reporting to highlight and mitigate risk.
* Act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders and stakeholders, building strong relationships to ensure alignment, articulate complex recommendations, and manage expectations.
* Leverage a range of methodologies including Agile, Lean, and Six Sigma to devise innovative solutions, streamline processes, and design future-state operating models.
* Manage, mentor, and coach team members to elicit their best performance, partnering with leadership to build skills and identify high-performing individuals.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability by reducing time-to-market, boosting quality, and capturing lessons learned to benefit the wider organization.
* Proactively identify and manage program risks by simplifying processes, eliminating redundancies, and anticipating necessary changes to business systems and tools.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 14 years of experience managing complex, end-to-end programs and process transformation projects, with required experience in management consulting and within the financial services industry.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required.
* Experience advising and leading operating model and process transformation programs within financial services, owning the development of business requirements, analytical frameworks, and project delivery reporting up to senior management sponsorship
* Demonstrated experience working with Technology teams to oversee delivery activities, support requirements implementation, helping achieve business objectives across delivery methodologies including Agile, Waterfall
* Proven expertise in a range of methodologies including Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, and structured PM frameworks; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor program managers on high-risk, cross-functional initiatives, driving accountability and ensuring alignment with broader firm-wide strategy.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Office Suite, including Excel, MS Project, and the use of PowerPoint for compelling, data-driven storytelling to senior leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and conduct in-depth analyses, develop business cases, and devise innovative, technology-integrated solutions.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to articulate complex recommendations and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Functional knowledge in one or more financial services domains such as Consumer/Institutional Banking, Risk Management, Compliance, Finance, or Operations.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, brings a high sense of urgency to goals, and balances analytical and creative abilities to drive change.

*This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.*

title: Audit Delivery Coordinator
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
As a highly organised and detail-oriented delivery professional, you will execute audit delivery activities across multiple Technology audit programs (including, but not limited to, JSOX, GS007, and Financial Statement Audits), supporting the effective and timely provision of audit evidence.
  
The role is accountable for coordinating the end-to-end evidence workflow for assigned scope, ensuring submissions are complete, on time, and aligned to audit expectations, with minimal rework or resubmission.
  
Working closely with control owners, SMEs, and the Audit Delivery Lead, you will manage evidence requests, compile submission packs, and support walkthrough readiness, while applying consistent quality checks to improve audit outcomes.
  
Over time, the role contributes to building a more proactive, repeatable delivery model by supporting a structured evidence-gathering cadence and improving overall audit readiness across Technology.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Support the shift from reactive audit delivery to a more structured and repeatable evidence cycle, maintaining readiness across assigned scope.
* Contribute to standardisation of audit delivery practices, including consistent evidence structure, naming conventions, and submission expectations.
* Identify recurring evidence issues and contribute to continuous improvement actions that improve quality and reduce rework.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Execute audit delivery across assigned scope, ensuring evidence is complete, accurate, and delivered on time.
* Coordinate inputs from control owners and SMEs, including tracking actions, clarifying requirements, and managing deadlines.
* Compile and prepare evidence packs for submission, ensuring they are well-structured and audit-ready.
* Perform consistent quality checks on submissions (e.g. completeness, correct period, population, approvals, and format).
* Manage resubmissions and follow-ups, ensuring feedback is addressed and closure is tracked.
* Coordinate walkthrough readiness (scheduling, materials, participant alignment, and artefact preparation).
* Progressively develop capability to gather evidence directly (where appropriate and approved) to improve turnaround time and consistency.
* Support a quarterly evidence cadence, improving currency of artefacts and reducing peak delivery pressure.

  
People Leadership 
  

* Build effective working relationships with control owners and SMEs to drive timely and high-quality outcomes.
* Communicate clearly on status, risks, and next steps, escalating early where delivery risk emerges.
* Reinforce expectations of audit-appropriate evidence, supporting gradual uplift in quality and consistency.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Ensure evidence is handled in a controlled and traceable manner, aligned to control intent.
* Maintain accurate delivery records to support transparency and defensibility of audit outcomes.
* Identify recurring evidence quality issues and feed insights to the Audit Delivery Lead to support remediation and uplift actions.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience 
  

* 3-5 years’ experience in coordination-based roles, ideally within audit or risk environments.
* Experience supporting structured delivery environments (audit, assurance, governance, risk, compliance, PMO, or control-based operations).
* Proven ability to manage competing deadlines and follow through on actions in a multi-stakeholder environment.
* Experience coordinating inputs from multiple stakeholders and managing delivery timelines to meet defined outcomes.
* Exposure to audit processes, evidence requirements, or control environments is advantageous.
* Experience working with documentation, artefact management, or structured evidence handling is beneficial.
* Familiarity with maintaining delivery records and tracking actions to support transparency and audit defensibility.

  
Personal Attributes
  

* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to consistently assess evidence for completeness, accuracy, and audit appropriateness.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working with control owners and SMEs to clarify requirements
* Process-oriented mindset, with a focus on consistency, repeatability, and continuous improvement.
* Analytical and systematic approach to work, with a practical, solution-oriented mindset.
* Collaborative working style
* Willingness to build technical and process knowledge over time to support greater ownership of evidence activities.

description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role is responsible for supporting the successful preparation and coordination of new products, features, and capabilities through effective cross-functional coordination, stakeholder management, and operational planning.
  
  
The ideal candidate excels at bringing clarity to complex initiatives, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, supporting stakeholder alignment, and coordinating execution against agreed launch plans.
  
  
They are natural communicators, critical thinkers, and problem solvers who can navigate ambiguity and ensure the team is equipped for successful product adoption and operational readiness work effectively within a complex environment and support teams in achieving product adoption and operational readiness.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Product Launch Process Execution
* Coordinate and support the execution of the product launch process across assigned products, features, and capabilities, identifying opportunities for improvement
* Coordinate launch planning activities, working with relevant stakeholders to define and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness reviews, track agreed actions, and follow up with participating teams
* Support consistent and efficient execution of launch activities in line with agreed objectives, processes, and best practices
* Monitor launch progress, identify potential blockers, and work with relevant stakeholders to address or escalate issues that may impact launch success
* Operational Readiness & Excellence

* Use agreed measures to monitor launch effectiveness and readiness outcomes, and support post-launch performance reporting and lessons learned

* Support structured decision-making by providing relevant information, highlighting competing priorities and escalating conflicting requirements where appropriate
* Work effectively across teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration, and maintaining momentum against agreed actions
* Ensure stakeholders remain informed through clear, concise, proactive, and timely communications
* Process Optimization
* Analyze existing launch and readiness activities and identify opportunities for improvement
* Use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to recommend improvements to operational efficiency and scalability
* Contribute to the development and adoption of repeatable approaches and best practices that improve consistency across product launches
* Use appropriate AI capabilities and tools, where suitable, to support efficient delivery and execution of launch activities
* Identify and escalate significant challenges, risks, and critical pain points through the appropriate governance channels

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to identify risks, dependencies, and practical solutions.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
We are hiring Senior / Lead Engineers to design, build, and scale robust, production-grade data and platform systems for a product portfolio within Blenheim. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end-to-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast-growing, product-led environment.
  
  
If you enjoy working with ambiguity, building platforms from the ground up, and shipping real business impact, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data-driven, outcome-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.
  
  
Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office locations in both Andheri East and Navi Mumbai.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
description:
As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you’ll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You’ll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
  
  
This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery.
  
  
Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7+ years of experience in hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
* Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
* Deep understanding of sales automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and related technologies, including ERP tools, payment automation, billing automation, and CPQ
* Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and an understanding of how to build cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Experience in the financial industry or B2B platforms is a plus

**Working Conditions**
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.
  
  
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

description:

title: Software Testing Engineer, Portfolio Management Group, Analyst
description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Testing Analyst to help deliver reliable web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-powered features. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to define quality criteria, identify risks early, and assess whether features are ready for release.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and define acceptance criteria, test plans, and regression scenarios.
* Assess AI-generated responses for relevance, factual support, consistency, and correct use of supporting sources.
* Validate data across application screens, APIs, databases, and generated outputs.
* Cover edge cases and failure scenarios, including invalid inputs, timeouts, interrupted requests, and access restrictions.
* Own defects from discovery through resolution: investigate issues, communicate their impact, and verify fixes.
* Build and maintain automated checks, reusable test data, and quality documentation.
* Communicate quality risks and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.

**Must know**

* Test-case design, manual testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Programming in Python, Java, or a similar language, with the ability to write validation scripts.
* API testing, including HTTP, JSON, and response validation.
* SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Test automation using a framework such as pytest, Selenium, or Playwright.
* SDLC, STLC, Git, and collaborative delivery practices.
* Structured problem-solving and clear communication.

**Good to know**

* Quality evaluation for AI applications, including prompt variations, unsupported claims, source grounding, and response quality.
* Large language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
* CI/CD pipelines, application logs, and browser developer tools.
* Accessibility, performance, and security testing.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, or substantial projects. We value someone who takes initiative and can drive quality from requirements through release.
  
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience

**Problem-Solving**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Team Lead – Implementation
description:
**About Clari5**
Clari5, a product of CustomerXPs (now part of the Perfios group), is a category-leading real-time Enterprise Financial Crime Management platform trusted by banks across 15+ countries. The platform processes 12 billion+ transactions and secures over 200 million accounts, helping financial institutions combat fraud, manage AML compliance, and drive revenue — all in real time. Clari5 is consistently recognised in Chartis RiskTech Quadrants and has won multiple global awards for fraud detection innovation.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Team Lead – Implementation is a high-impact delivery role within Clari5’s Global Professional Services team. You will lead end-to-end implementation engagements of the Clari5 platform at banking and financial institution clients, owning project delivery from kick-off to go-live. You will manage a small squad of functional and technical consultants, serve as the primary client interface during implementation, and ensure every deployment meets Clari5’s quality, timeline, and customer-satisfaction benchmarks.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of banking domain expertise, product knowledge, and project leadership — ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment and wants to shape how one of the world’s most advanced fraud management platforms goes live at marquee banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implementation Delivery

+ Own end-to-end delivery of Clari5 implementations from project initiation to go-live and hypercare, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, and quality benchmarks.
+ Create and maintain detailed project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, and status dashboards for each engagement.
+ Drive sub-90-day go-live timelines by leveraging Clari5’s pre-built integration adapters and accelerators.
+ Manage parallel implementation streams (EFM, AML, Case Management) across banking channels and core banking integrations.
+ Coordinate UAT cycles, defect triage, and sign-off activities with client teams.
+ Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management

+ Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders (CTO, CIO, Risk Heads, IT teams) throughout the implementation lifecycle.
+ Conduct requirement-gathering workshops, present solution design documents, and validate functional configurations against client needs.
+ Manage client expectations proactively; communicate changes in scope, risk, and mitigation plans transparently.
+ Build lasting relationships that support successful post-go-live adoption and open doors for further engagement.
+ Team Leadership

+ Lead, mentor, and guide a team of 3–5 functional/technical consultants across implementation engagements.
+ Assign work, track deliverables, and conduct performance reviews for team members.
+ Foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and delivery excellence.
+ Onboard and ramp new team members on Clari5 product, banking domain, and delivery methodology.
+ Technical & Functional Oversight

+ Review and sign off on Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Interface Requirement Documents (IRDs), and test plans.
+ Oversee and validate configurations of fraud rules, AML scenarios, case workflows, and reporting dashboards.
+ Liaise with the Clari5 product engineering and DevOps teams on environment setups, deployments, patches, and escalations.
+ Ensure integrations with core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, Temenos, etc.), payment switches, and ancillary systems are correctly designed and executed.
+ Process & Quality

+ Enforce Clari5’s implementation methodology, quality gates, and project governance standards across all engagements.
+ Contribute to the development and improvement of delivery playbooks, templates, and best-practice documentation.
+ Conduct post-go-live reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery quality.
+ Identify and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner with clear mitigation plans.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Must Have


+ 7–10 years of experience in banking technology delivery, with at least 3 years in a team lead or project lead capacity.
+ Hands-on experience implementing banking software products (fraud management, core banking, AML, payments, or similar enterprise banking solutions).
+ Strong working knowledge of banking channels and operations: Core Banking, Payments (RTGS/NEFT/UPI/SWIFT), Cards, Mobile/Internet Banking.
+ Experience preparing and reviewing BRDs, SDDs, IRDs, test plans, and go-live checklists.
+ Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum or Waterfall) and tools (Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent).
+ Unix Shell script/ Python/ Database(RDBMS, Oracle/MYSQL/MSSQL)/ Java Debugging etc
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and engagements.
+ Willingness to travel to client sites domestically and internationally.

* Good to Have


+ Prior experience implementing Fraud / AML platforms.
+ Exposure to integration middleware and API-based integrations (REST/SOAP) in a banking context.
+ Understanding of regulatory frameworks: RBI guidelines, FATF AML, PMLA, IRDAI, or regional equivalents.
+ PMP, Prince2, or equivalent project management certification.
+ Experience with BI/reporting tools and SQL for data validation during implementations.
+ Knowledge of real-time decisioning architectures, rule engines, and in-memory computing concepts.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project & program management
* Team supervision & mentoring
* Risk & issue management
* Stakeholder communication

**Domain & Technical**

* Banking products & channels
* Fraud / AML platform configuration
* Core banking integrations
* SQL, APIs, test management tools

What We Offer
  
  

* Work on world-class fraud management technology deployed at Tier 1 banks across Asia, Middle East, and Africa.
* Exposure to complex, large-scale enterprise implementations — including the world’s largest real-time fraud management deployment.
* A dynamic, high-ownership environment where your impact is visible and your contributions are recognised.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities for global travel and cross-geography client engagement.
* A collaborative team of banking technology veterans committed to delivery excellence.
* Access to Clari5’s continuous learning resources, product certifications, and industry events.

title: Quality Engineering Manager
description:
**Build the payment infrastructure powering global commerce.**
**Boku connects billions of consumers to the payment methods they prefer, one market at a time. Our platform connects the world’s leading digital businesses to the local payment methods their customers already use. Spotify, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix and Tencent already run on Boku’s payment infrastructure. We operate across 60+ countries, support 200+ local payment methods and reach 7.5 billion consumer accounts.**
**With headquarters in London and San Francisco and colleagues working across markets around the world, Boku is global by default. From London to Mumbai, São Paulo to Singapore, our teams collaborate across time zones, markets and cultures to build products for customers around the world.**
**Join us to solve complex, real-time payment challenges at global scale. We share knowledge freely, take ownership of complexity and look for people who question how things are done and find better ways to build.**
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Quality Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing team of SDETs responsible for delivering quality engineering across critical payment and settlement platforms. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, leading talented teams, influencing stakeholders across the business, and driving quality at scale. You will operate in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, multiple initiatives run in parallel, and collaboration across Product, Engineering, Operations, Security, and Platform teams is essential.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with technical credibility, enabling them to guide automation strategy, make informed decisions in ambiguous situations, and advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and leading teams through rapidly changing priorities.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Lead and Develop High-Performing Teams**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of SDETs
* Create an environment focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence
* Support career development, coaching, performance management, and hiring activities

**Drive Quality Engineering Excellence**

* Define and evolve testing strategies, automation frameworks, and quality practices
* Partner with Engineering and Product teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle
* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation effectiveness, reliability, and release confidence
* Review technical approaches and provide guidance on automation, testing architecture, and quality risks

**Manage Complex Programs and Stakeholders**

* Lead quality initiatives across multiple concurrent projects and workstreams
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, and Platform teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment
* Balance competing priorities and make effective decisions in dynamic, fast-changing environments
* Communicate risks, trade-offs, and delivery expectations clearly to stakeholders

**Drive Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and track quality metrics, test effectiveness, automation coverage, and delivery performance
* Champion process improvements and engineering best practices
* Drive adoption of modern testing approaches, including AI-assisted quality engineering and automation

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering
* 3+ years of people management experience leading SDET or QA teams
* Proven experience leading quality engineering teams within product-based organizations
* Strong technical background in test automation, quality engineering, and engineering best practices
* Hands-on experience with Java and automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, or similar
* Experience testing distributed systems and microservices-based applications
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and drive outcomes
* Experience with CI/CD, cloud technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, or AWS is a plus
* FinTech, Payments, Banking, or Settlement domain experience is preferred

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on large-scale global payment platforms
* Lead a talented and growing quality engineering team
* Influence engineering practices across the organization
* Solve complex technical and business challenges
* Work in an environment where you can influence strategy, challenge the status quo, and drive meaningful change

If you're a technically credible people leader who thrives in complex environments, enjoys influencing stakeholders, and is passionate about building high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager - Data & Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
  
  
As Bluehost scales, reliability and good data both depend on strong platform engineering. You'll lead the team that keeps our infrastructure resilient and our data trustworthy — from cloud architecture and containerized hosting to backup/disaster recovery, observability, and the pipelines that turn raw data into insight for product and growth teams across a fast-growing SMB SaaS platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark**
This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a small team while staying hands-on as a software engineer yourself.
  
  
As a manager
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of ~4 engineers spanning data engineering, devops, cloud infrastructure, hosting solutions, and observability — hiring, mentoring, and owning performance and career development.
* Set technical direction and priorities across the team's full portfolio: data pipelines, public cloud configuration, containerized hosting, backup/disaster recovery, observability, and internal automation.
* Partner directly with product, analytics, security, and engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business needs into infrastructure and data roadmaps.
* Drive on-call and incident-response practices so pipeline, cloud, and hosting issues are caught before they hit customers or a dashboard.
* Report on team health, system reliability, and roadmap progress to leadership.

As an engineer
  
  

* Personally design, build, and maintain production systems across the team's domains — pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized services, and automation — not just review others' work.
* Write and review code for data pipelines, devops tooling, cloud configuration (infrastructure-as-code), observability instrumentation, and backup/recovery solutions.
* Own or co-own the most complex or cross-cutting technical problems — architecture decisions, major incidents, and backup/DR strategy and testing.
* Use AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up your own development and debugging, and help the team adopt them effectively.
* Write tested, version-controlled code and contribute to CI/CD practices that catch regressions — data-quality, infrastructure, or otherwise — before they ship.
* Document architecture, data models, lineage, and operational runbooks so other teams can self-serve with confidence.

**Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed**

* 4-6 years of hands-on engineering experience across data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, or devops, including some experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, or formally managing a team.
* Real experience building and operating production systems — not just one-off scripts — across at least two of: data pipelines, devops, cloud infrastructure, containerized hosting, observability, or backup/DR.
* Solid experience with relational databases and dimensional data-warehousing concepts, and strong SQL skills.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud) — configuration, cost management, and security fundamentals.
* Experience with containerized hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar).
* Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or similar) and backup/disaster-recovery practices.
* Working proficiency in Python (preferred) or another language commonly used for data or platform engineering.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development, debugging, and validation.
* Strong communicator, able to translate ambiguous business needs into technical plans for both your team and stakeholders.

Bonus
  
  

* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse), orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), or event-streaming tools (Kafka).
* Prior experience formally managing an engineering team.

**Why You'll Love Us**

* We’ve evolved. we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

#Bluehost
  
  
**This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.**

title: Manager, Software Development
description:
The Software Development Manager is a vital position in our organization as we grow our software development environment and expand our IT department in Mumbai. Our Software Development department delivers solutions that enable and empower both internal and external customers to manage their business processes most effectively and efficiently. This individual will be tasked with accelerating the modernization of Medpace clinical and administrative software.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage software engineers and software development projects to implement effective and high-quality software solutions;
* Collect, analyze, and document user requirements;
* Perform project management, ensure system quality and oversee content management;
* Coordinate with company-wide leadership regarding software development projects;
* Design, modify, develop, support, install, and document software applications;
* Participate in software quality control and validation processes through development, code review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
* Train software engineers and end users; and
* Identify process deficiencies and propose improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related area, with eight years of software development and three years of project lead experience;
* Prior experience in project management, execution, and delivery to customers, and in direct management of a development team;
* Development Experience with Microsoft technologies such as .NET and SQL Server;
* Development Experience in web based technologies such as Angular;
* Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English;
* Knowledge of Azure and SharePoint technologies preferred; and
* Experience in a clinical (or regulated) environment is a plus!

**Medpace Overview**
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
  
  
**Why Medpace?**
When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
***Purpose-Driven Work***




+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

***Collaborative Culture***




+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

***Continuous Growth & Development***




+ Office based environment with on-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

**Other Employee Benefits**




+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company-sponsored social events

*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*
**What To Expect Next**
A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
