title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward-Deployed Engineer / AI Product Manager

Tuning Research · India (hybrid, at client sites)

About Tuning Research

Tuning Research is an applied AI engineering company, founded by IIT Kanpur alumni, that builds production-grade agentic AI systems for enterprises. We’re a 20-person team that works as an extended AI team for our clients across knowledge and documents, business operations, video intelligence, voice AI and marketing automation.

About the role

We’re hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Product Manager to own client transformations end to end: scope it, design it, build parts of it, ship it, and get it used.

You’ll be the one person from Tuning Research who lives inside the client’s business. Typically that’s a mid-to-large Indian enterprise replacing spreadsheets and legacy systems (HRMS, ERP, accounts, operations) with AI-native software. You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. A small remote team of AI, full-stack and mobile engineers works with you, and our founders stay closely involved.

The title says product manager, but the job is closer to a forward-deployed engineer: half product, half engineering, all of it on the customer’s ground.

What a week looks like

* Monday: At the client’s office. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.
* Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.
* Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.
* Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.
* Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.

What you’ll do

*Scope the right thing*

* Run discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.
* Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.
* Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.

*Own the client relationship*

* Be the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.
* Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.
* Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.

*Design the system*

* Own the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.
* Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.

*Build, verify and deploy*

* Write backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.
* Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.
* Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.

*Design the experience and drive adoption*

* Design screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.
* Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.
* Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.

What you need

* 3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.
* Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.
* Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.
* Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).
* Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.
* Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.
* Fluent Hindi and English.
* Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.

Nice to have

* You’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.
* Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.
* You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.
* You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.
* You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.

Who succeeds here

You have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.

Work setup

* Location: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.
* Travel: Regular visits to client sites.
* Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.
* Reports to: Tuning Research founders.
* Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.

What success looks like

* 30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.
* 90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.
* 6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.
* 12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.

How we hire

1. Intro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.
2. Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. You run the conversation and play back what you’d build.
3. Take-home (one weekend): Build a small API that uses an LLM to extract a real-world business document into structured fields. Add a one-page spec and one Figma screen for the end user.
4. Code and design review (60 min): Walk us through the take-home, and we review a pull request together.
5. Founders’ conversation: Working style, travel and expectations.

description: We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling our test automation ecosystem — owning quality end-to-end, from test design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust, reliable, and release-ready at all times.What You'll Do Design, build & maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG. Own test strategy for assigned squads — defining scope, coverage, and risk from requirements through production. Write BDD feature files (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product stakeholders. Implement TDD practices — writing tests before or alongside code to drive quality in development cycles. Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback. Perform API testing and validate end-to-end user journeys across web and services. Identify, document & triage defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and root-cause analysis. Mentor junior QA engineers and champion quality best practices across the engineering org. Continuously evaluate test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps — iterating to keep automation suite trustworthy.What We're Looking For Must-Have Skills 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation in a product engineering environment. Strong proficiency with Selenium WebDriver — page object model, explicit waits, cross-browser testing. Solid experience with Cucumber (BDD) — writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks. Hands-on with TestNG — test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, and reporting. Working knowledge of TDD principles and integrating tests into agile development workflows. Proficiency in at least one programming language — Java or Python preferred. Experience with CI/CD integration and running tests in automated pipelines. Strong analytical thinking with an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes. Excellent communication skills — ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to Have Domain knowledge in Payments — understanding of payment flows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems. Experience testing APIs with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar. Familiarity with performance / load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6). Exposure to cloud testing environments (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm). Knowledge of security testing basics relevant to financial or transactional systems. Experience with mobile automation (Appium or similar). The Mindset We Value Beyond technical skills, we hire for how you think and operate: Ownership mindset — you treat quality as your personal responsibility, not a sign-off gate. You proactively identify risks, flag issues early, and see bugs as a systemic problem to solve. Shift-left thinking — you involve yourself in requirements and design discussions, not just execution phase. Bias for automation — if something is tested manually more than twice, you ask how to automate it. Collaborative — you work with developers as partners, not adversaries, and build shared ownership of quality. Continuous improvement — you regularly revisit your frameworks and practices, improving coverage, speed, and reliability.Location: Mumbai - UI, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

title: MIST - Delivery Manager
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  
**Delivery Manager – Model Development**
Working within the
**Model Implementation & Support**
team, part of the
**Actuarial Modelling & Valuations**
function in
**M&G Finance**
, this role is responsible for coordinating the delivery of model development activity across a complex portfolio of change. The role requires
**strong delivery management experience**
, with the ability to turn agreed scope into clear plans, coordinate stakeholders across teams, and maintain momentum through effective tracking, issue management and communication.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Scope & prioritisation
  
  

* Collate and shape model development scope, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives, and that changes to agreed scope are assessed and agreed through a change control process
* Coordinate input to assess effort, dependencies and delivery options
* Support agreement of funding and resource allocation with relevant budget holders

Delivery planning & execution
  
  

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans with named owners, milestones, dependencies and progress tracking
* Drive disciplined execution through effective resource planning, RAID management and regular check-ins with delivery owners
* Ensure delivery activity remains aligned across workstreams and that emerging issues are surfaced early

Progress & risk management
  
  

* Provide regular progress updates, including clear issue flagging, escalation routes and recommended actions
* Track costs against agreed funding and highlight any emerging risks or pressures
* Maintain RAID logs, supporting timely resolution

Governance & stakeholder communication
  
  

* Prepare materials for key meetings and governance forums, track actions and ensure appropriate follow-up
* Support engagement with internal review teams and external audit where required
* Provide clear communication to stakeholders on progress, risks, dependencies and actions needed to keep delivery on track

Cross-initiative coordination
  
  

* Coordinate delivery across related model development initiatives to support joined-up implementation and effective handover into valuation and reporting processes

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Strong delivery management capability, including planning, prioritisation, dependency management and progress tracking
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear updates on progress, risks, dependencies and actions required
* Good understanding of governance, change control, RAID management and issue escalation disciplines
* Ability to coordinate across multiple workstreams and maintain delivery momentum in a complex change environment

**Experience**
7 - 10 years
  
  
Experience of coordinating delivery activity across a portfolio of model development or change initiatives, including scope shaping, effort assessment, milestone planning and dependency management.
  
  
Experience of working with senior stakeholders, delivery owners, budget holders and governance forums to support timely decisions, funding/resource alignment and effective escalation of risks and issues.
  
  
Experience within actuarial, finance, model development, valuation, reporting or a similar controlled delivery environment would be advantageous.
  
  
**Educational Qualification:**

* Graduate degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, AgilePM, Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist or equivalent delivery/project management qualification is desirable.
* Postgraduate qualification such as MBA, MSc, MCom, CA, CFA or equivalent professional qualification would be advantageous.
* Actuarial qualifications or progress towards actuarial exams would be beneficial but not mandatory.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
Location: Andheri, Mumbai
  
  
**About BOMBAYDC**
BOMBAYDC is a strategic digital platform firm helping enterprises build intelligent digital platforms that increase adoption, retention and revenue.
  
  
We work at the intersection of strategy, product, design, technology and AI to turn complex business problems into products people actually use.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We're looking for an AI Product Builder who can take a product from client requirement to working prototype.
  
  
This is not a traditional Product Manager, Designer or Developer role. You’ll operate across all three — understanding the problem, defining the product, designing the experience and using AI-native tools to rapidly build and prototype the solution.
  
  
You should be comfortable taking an idea from “Here’s the problem” → “Here’s what we should build” → “Here’s the working prototype.”
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Understand client requirements, business goals and user problems
* Translate ambiguous requirements into clear product concepts and user flows
* Define product scope, features and MVPs
* Design intuitive UX/UI and product experiences
* Use AI and no/low-code tools to rapidly build functional prototypes
* Work with engineers and designers to take concepts further
* Manage the project end-to-end — from discovery to prototype delivery
* Present ideas and prototypes to clients and incorporate feedback quickly
* Make smart trade-offs between user experience, business requirements and technical feasibility
* Use AI tools extensively across research, ideation, design, development and documentation

**You'll Probably Enjoy This Role If You Have**

* Strong product thinking with good UX/UI fundamentals
* Experience taking products from problem definition to prototype
* A builder mindset — you like making things, not just documenting them
* Comfort working directly with clients and senior stakeholders
* Ability to independently manage projects and coordinate designers and developers
* Strong understanding of modern AI tools and AI-native product development
* Ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies
* Strong communication, ownership and execution skills
* Curiosity about how AI is changing the way products are built

Experience across B2B SaaS, Banking, FinTech, Enterprise Platforms, Commerce or AI products is valuable.
  
  
**Success In This Role**
Within 3–6 months, you should be able to independently take a client problem, define the right product direction and deliver a high-quality working prototype.
  
  
Over time, we expect you to become someone who can own entire product initiatives — from client conversation to shipped experience.
  
  
**What You'll Get**

* Opportunity to work on complex enterprise products
* Direct exposure to clients, founders and senior leadership
* Freedom to experiment with AI-native tools and workflows
* Ownership from problem definition to product delivery
* One remote working day every week
* Extended year-end winter break of 7 days
* Clear growth opportunities as the company scales

**Our Culture**
We're a fairly ambitious company and we care deeply about the quality of our work.
  
  
We don't believe in working long hours for the sake of it, but we do believe in ownership and doing what's required to deliver great outcomes.
  
  
People here get a lot of responsibility very early. We value curiosity, independent thinking, attention to detail and a desire to continuously improve.
  
  
We're not a highly process-heavy or layered organization.
  
  
We expect people to ask good questions, challenge assumptions and keep raising the bar for themselves and the team.
  
  
We welcome people who are excited about building for the new world with AI. We move very fast. You should too.
  
  
If you enjoy moving between product, design, technology, AI and client conversations — and want to build real products rather than just manage them — you'll probably enjoy this role.
  
  
Apply through LinkedIn or drop an email to work@bombaydc.com with your resume and portfolio.

You will create clarity, strengthen team ownership, remove barriers and help teams deliver valuable outcomes with pace, quality and predictability.

* Support readiness for stakeholder demonstrations, releases and key delivery milestones.
* Share effective practices through the Agile community and mentor teams as their maturity develops.

 We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master who combines strong Agile practice with sound judgement, commercial awareness and the confidence to coach teams in a complex Financial Services environment.
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* 7\+ years of overall professional experience, including substantial experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery practitioner.
* Proven experience supporting multiple Scrum teams in complex technology environments.
* Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, Agile principles and iterative product delivery.
* A track record of facilitating engaging, purposeful meetings that lead to clear decisions and actions.
* Experience coaching teams to take ownership of delivery, ways of working and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify delivery risks, dependencies, impediments and emerging conflict early.
* Experience partnering with Product Owners on prioritisation, backlog clarity and outcome\-focused planning.
* Confidence working with senior engineering, product and business stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Experience in Financial Services, fintech, banking, capital markets, trading or another regulated environment.
* A genuine interest in financial markets, investment management, digital assets and cryptocurrency.
* Strong communication, facilitation, influencing and conflict\-resolution skills.


**Experience That Would Set You Apart**

* Experience working with US\-based or globally distributed product and engineering teams.
* Practical experience with Scrum of Scrums, cross\-team planning or scaled delivery environments.
* Experience using delivery metrics and evidence to improve flow, predictability and team effectiveness.
* Contribution to Agile communities of practice or wider organisational capability development.
* Recognised Agile or Scrum certification, supported by strong practical delivery experience.

**Additional Information**

 At Version 1, you will deepen your expertise within our Financial Services practice while supporting complex technology delivery for a global organisation operating across trading, investment management and digital assets.

**Job Summary**

 **Real Living Wage** 
 employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!
   

  

**Our Product \& Engineering Team:**
 Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth\-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data \& Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real\-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
   

  

 Engineering is going through an AI\-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
   

  

 Our Salesforce Team:
   

  

 You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well\-built Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 The role:
   

  

 As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
   

  

 You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
   

  

 You’ll remain hands\-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
   

  

 Success in the role means consistently delivering high\-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
   

  

 What you’ll get to do:
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.


 What we think you’ll need:
   

  

* Proven success in a hands\-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.


**Next steps** 
 If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
   

  

 Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
   

  

**Our hybrid approach**
 Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

 Product Intern

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern
   

  

 You’ll join the Product team and work closely with Product Managers on building and improving products across the investing journey, with a focus on the Mutual Funds and Advisory space.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on product \+ data role where you’ll work across product requirements, analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and execution. You’ll use SQL and product analytics tools to understand how users interact with our products, identify opportunities, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and insights into products that customers can use. You won’t just look at the numbers you’ll help understand what they mean for the product and what we should do next.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — defining requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and keeping documentation updated as features evolve.
* Work with the product backlog — help groom, prioritise, and organise requirements so the team stays focused on what matters.
* Own product analytics — build and analyse dashboards, funnels, and key product metrics to understand user behaviour and feature performance.
* Use SQL to answer product questions — write basic queries using filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data without always depending on the data team.
* Analyse user behaviour through tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude — build funnels, retention reports, and cohorts and understand what the numbers mean for the product.
* Turn data into insights — identify trends, drop\-offs, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Run competitive intelligence across investing, wealth\-tech, and broader fintech platforms. Track product launches, UX changes, features, and pricing.
* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements and insights into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, SQL analysis, documentation, dashboarding, testing, competitive analysis, and the detailed work that turns product questions into real improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our
 **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice** 
 , which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").

* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long\-term commitment with the team and organization


**Specific Qualifications**

* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,
* A very good English level is mandatory,


 Qualification
   

  

 :
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field; Master’s degree or certifications such as TOGAF are a plus.

* Strong expertise in Java, microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event\-driven architecture

* Knowledge of security principles and best practices for securing applications and data.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills with a focus on performance optimization.

**About the Role and Team:**
 The Team Lead, UX Design is responsible for leading a small team of UX Designers while actively contributing to product design delivery. This role ensures that high\-quality, user\-centered design solutions are delivered across assigned product areas, while continuously improving design practices, team capabilities, and collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders. In addition to hands\-on design responsibilities, this role focuses on developing team members, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring alignment between UX design activities, product goals, and business objectives.
   

  

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of UX Designers by setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional growth. Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture with strong ownership and accountability.
* UX Design Delivery: Contribute to and lead the design thinking cycle by proactively identifying user problems and opportunities and delivering UX design solutions across all phases of the Product Development Process (discovery, scope analysis, development, and validation).
* Design Quality and Consistency: Ensure high standards of UX design quality across the team by applying and evolving the UX design framework, design system, and best practices. Promote consistency and scalability of design solutions. Designs are web / desktop focused.
* Work Planning and Prioritization: Plan and prioritize UX design activities across the team, ensuring alignment with Product Development Process phases, product priorities, and delivery timelines to maximize impact.

* Recruitment and Talent Growth: Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of UX Designers. Participate in hiring processes and contribute to building a strong design organization.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Ensure alignment between UX design outcomes and broader product and business objectives. Communicate design decisions clearly and influence stakeholders effectively.

* Strong understanding of the how UX design contributes across all phases of product development process (discovery, scope definition, development, validation, release)

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**

title: Senior Agile Procurement Expert – Negotiation Design & Support
description:
**About DHL and Procurement:** 




  





 DHL Group, the world’s leading logistics provider, employs over 580,000 people across more than 220 countries and territories. We’re more than just a company moving goods around—we’re on a mission to
 **Connect People. Improve Lives.**

 **SUSTAINABLE, AGILE, CONNECTED, FORWARD\-LOOKING** 
 .
 



  





 We’re transforming how DHL sources products, systems, and services by leveraging modern digital tools and technologies.
 



**The Agile Procurement Team (APT)**

 As a Negotiation Expert within our Procurement team, you will be at the forefront of implementing best procurement initiatives. Your focus will be on infusing innovative negotiation strategies into the organization, ensuring that we deliver high\-impact projects that align with our business objectives, cost parameters, and quality standards.

* Develop and execute project management plans for Procurement Focus Plus projects, ensuring they meet quality, timeline, and budget requirements.
* Lead and mentor project teams, providing direction and oversight to ensure successful project outcomes.

* Identify operational challenges and implement solutions to minimize project delays and risks.
* **Drive innovative negotiation designs and strategies that leverage best practices, including game theory, to optimize outcomes in sourcing and procurement.**
* Support strategic sourcing by conducting supply market research and intelligence to inform business decisions and budget planning.
* Develop and manage strategic supplier relationships, identifying opportunities for cost reduction while ensuring quality and supply reliability.
* Act as a liaison between stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout project lifecycles.
* **Train and coach colleagues on advanced negotiation techniques and best practices, contributing to the development of negotiation success stories within DHL.**



  





**Your Profile:** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in procurement or sales, with a focus on negotiation.
* Demonstrated expertise in negotiation, with the ability to articulate best practices and theoretical knowledge in real\-world applications.
* Proven experience in managing large\-scale projects, including at least three significant sourcing initiatives.
* Strong analytical skills with a track record of interpreting and utilizing data to drive decisions.
* Problem\-solving skills with a consultative approach, prioritizing business needs to identify and implement effective solutions.
* Familiarity with procurement systems, tools, and a digital mindset.
* Proven experience applying game theory and other advanced negotiation techniques in sourcing and tender design.
* Fluent in English.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* An opportunity to work with the world’s largest logistics company.
* An international and dynamic work environment.
* Flexibility and continuous learning opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to be part of a team that drives strategic change within one of the world’s leading companies. If you are passionate about negotiation, eager to share your expertise, and ready to contribute to a team that influences critical business decisions, we want to hear from you.
 



  





 DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands \- deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real\-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end\-to\-end from the first conversation to go\-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**We're The Perfect Match If You**
* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI\-first and hands\-on \- you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can\-do attitude \- when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence \- equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product \& Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity \- you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.


**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients \- from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go\-live \- within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams \- and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on\-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once \- tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.


 Why IDfy
   

  

 At IDfy, we don't just build products \- we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
   

  

 If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins \- this is your playground.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

description:
Title : Product Intern
   

  

 Location : Mumbai
   

  

 Work arrangement: 5 days in the office
   

  

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern – US Stocks
   

  

 You’ll join the US Stocks Product team and help build and scale products that enable Indian investors to invest in the US stock market.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 product role where you’ll work across product discovery, research, competitive intelligence, partner evaluation, and integrations. You’ll work closely with design, engineering, growth, and external partners to turn ideas into products that customers can use. You won’t inherit a finished playbook, you'll help build it.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — scoping requirements, chasing open questions, and keeping execution on track.
* Run competitive intelligence across Indian and global US\-stock investing platforms. Track what competitors are building, break down their features, and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the US Stocks investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and the overall investing journey.
* Identify and evaluate vendors and partners required for the product, including market data, trading infrastructure, payments, compliance\-related services, and other third\-party solutions.
* Drive integrations end to end, coordinating with external partners and internal teams to get third\-party services live and working smoothly.
* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Growth, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, analysis, documentation, partner coordination, testing, and the unglamorous wiring that turns an early idea into a real product.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Very hands\-on with AI. You use AI daily to research, prototype, analyze, draft, and move faster — and you’re constantly figuring out new ways to use it.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about investing, financial products, and how users interact with them.
* Interest in US Stocks and global investing is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem and turn it into a clear, structured document.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving US Stocks Product team, building products that open up global investing opportunities for Indian investors.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to 0\-to\-1 product building, global investing, fintech partnerships, integrations, competitive intelligence, and product execution — while owning real problems and seeing your work go live.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").
   

  

 I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.
   

  

 Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin.
